result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `Scoping*` tests in the `codeanalyzer` module pass. I didn't add new tests, so the new matches (`.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`) are untested.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, which listed `html` twice. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **Generated code:** `.*/[.]xml` (the `<doc>` rule) is now `.*[.]xml`, and `.*/[.]js` (the `// Generated by …` rule) is now `.*[.]js`. They previously needed a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`.
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is still covered by the separate `.*[.]gradle` rule.

The two generated-code rules also check file content (a `<doc>` line, or a `// Generated by` line), so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
